description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget for a video player screen, allowing playback of a video from a provided URL or a default sample. It manages video controls, play/pause, seek, volume, and displays progress, with proper lifecycle management.

classes.name: VideoPlayerScreen
classes.description: A public widget class that serves as an entry point for the video player screen, accepting an optional video URL.

classes.name: _VideoPlayerScreenState
classes.description: The internal state class managing the video player lifecycle, controls, and UI updates.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the video controller with either the provided URL or a default sample video. Sets volume, starts playback, and manages error handling.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the video controller to free resources.

methods.name: _buildControls
methods.description: Builds the playback control UI including play/pause, seek, volume, and slider.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the main widget layout including video display, progress indicator, and controls.
